title: S--Trash and Recycling Collection Services Lake Mead National Recreation Area
description: Lake Mead National Recreation Area - Trash and Recycling Collection Services  The National Park Service is considering a services requirement for trash and recycling collection services at Lake Mead National Recreation Area (LAKE) in accordance with the attached draft Statement of Work. This is a follow-on requirement to the current trash and recycling collection contract at LAKE with the intent of being awarded as a base plus four option years contract. The National Park Service is conducting this Request for Information (RFI) to seek out capable sources to fulfil this requirement. Additionally, this market research will be used to determine if a small business or other socioeconomic set-aside should be used when the requirement is solicited. The NAICS for this requirement is 562111 ¿ Solid Waste Collection with a Small Business Size Standard of $47M in average annual receipts.  Qualified firms shall submit a capability statement on company letterhead demonstrating the firm¿s qualifications to the contracting specialist, Caleb Overbaugh, at caleb_overbaugh@ios.doi.gov by the specified due date. Responses must be complete and sufficiently detailed to address the specific information. The documentation shall also address the following:  Company Profile to include:  1.	Company name, address, and Unique Entity ID (UEID), as registered in the System for Award Management (SAM) at http://www.sam.gov/  2.	Small Business designation/status (must correlate with SAM registration):   _____ Small business	_____	HUBZone	_____ WOSB  _____ 8(a)			_____ VOSB		_____ SDVOSB	 		 _____ Small Disadvantaged Business			______ ISBEE  3.	Relevant prior experience report showing a history of working as a prime or sub-contractor self-performing similar work or as a prime contractor managing subcontractors performing this type of work.   4.	A statement of the contractor¿s capability to comply with the key personnel requirements specified in the draft Statement of Work.  5.	Any questions or comments to help us clarify the specifications  ***NOTE: This is a market research tool being utilized for informational and planning purposes. Your responses will assist the Government in the development of its acquisition strategy for a possible Request for Quote (RFQ), to be issued at a later date, and in determining whether any type of small business set-aside is possible for this procurement or whether full and open competitive procedures should be utilized. If full and open competition is ultimately pursued, responses to this synopsis will be used to aid in establishing small business subcontracting goals.  This notice shall not be construed as a RFQ or as any commitment or obligation on the part of the Government to issue a solicitation. The Government does not intend to award a contract on the basis of this request, so proposals will not be considered. No reimbursement will be made for any costs associated with providing information in response to this synopsis or any follow-up information requests. Response is strictly voluntary - it is not mandatory to submit a response to this notice to participate in any formal RFP process that may take place in the future. However, it should be noted that information gathered through this notice may significantly influence our acquisition strategy. All interested parties will be required to respond separately to any solicitations posted as a result of this RFI. Respondents will not be notified of the results of the evaluation. We appreciate your interest and thank you in advance for responding to the Sources Sought.
